mn140:3.4: ‘sace te bhikkhu agaru, viharema āvesane ekarattinti.
mn140:4.1: atha kho bhagavā kumbhakārāvesanaṃ pavisitvā ekamantaṃ tiṇasanthārakaṃ paññāpetvā nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn140:4.2: atha kho bhagavā bahudeva rattiṃ nisajjāya vītināmesi.
mn140:4.3: āyasmāpi kho pukkusāti bahudeva rattiṃ nisajjāya vītināmesi.
mn140:4.7: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ pukkusātiṃ etadavoca:
mn140:5.1: ‘kaṃsi tvaṃ bhikkhu uddissa pabbajito, ko vā te satthā, kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesī’ti.

mn140:5.3: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn140:5.4: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
mn140:5.8: kahaṃ pana bhikkhu, etarahi so bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho’ti:
mn140:5.9: atthāvuso, uttaresu janapadesu sāvatthi nāma nagaraṃ.
mn140:5.10: tattha so bhagavā etarahi viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho’ti.
mn140:5.13: na kho me āvuso, diṭṭhapubbo so bhagavā.

mn140:6.6: taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmī’ti.
mn140:6.7: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā pukkusāti bhagavato paccassosi.

mn140:14.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ. seyyathidaṃ:
mn140:14.5: kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ, yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ.
mn140:14.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā paṭhavīdhātu yā ca bāhirā paṭhavīdhātu, paṭhavīdhāturevesā.
mn140:14.8: taṃ netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn140:14.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā paṭhavīdhātuyā nibbindati, paṭhavīdhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn140:15.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ. seyyathidaṃ:
mn140:15.5: pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttaṃ. yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ.
mn140:15.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā āpodhātu yā ca bāhirā āpodhātu, āpodhāturevesā.
mn140:15.8: taṃ netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn140:15.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā āpodhātuyā nibbindati, āpodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn140:16.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ. seyyathidaṃ:
mn140:16.5: yena ca santappati yena ca jīrīyati, yena ca pariḍayhati, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ.
mn140:16.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā tejodhātu yā ca bāhirā tejodhātu, tejodhāturevesā.
mn140:16.8: taṃ netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn140:16.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā tejodhātuyā nibbindati, tejodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn140:17.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ. seyyathidaṃ:
mn140:17.5: uddhaṅgamā vātā adhogamā vātā kucchisayā vātā koṭṭhasayā vātā aṅgamaṅgānusārino vātā assāso passāso, iti yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ.
mn140:17.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā vāyodhātu, yā ca bāhirā vāyodhātu, vāyodhāturevesā.
mn140:17.8: taṃ netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.

mn140:18.5: kaṇṇacchiddaṃ nāsacchiddaṃ mukhadvāraṃ yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ ajjhoharati, yattha ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ santiṭṭhati, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ adhobhāgā nikkhamati, yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ aghaṃ aghagataṃ vivaraṃ vivaragataṃ asamphuṭṭhaṃ maṃsalohitehi upādinnaṃ.

mn140:20.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhu, dakkho suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakārantevāsī vā ukkaṃ bandheyya, ukkaṃ bandhitvā ukkāmukhaṃ ālimpeyya, ukkāmukhaṃ ālimpetvā saṇḍāsena jātarūpaṃ gahetvā ukkāmukhe pakkhipeyya. tamenaṃ kālena kālaṃ abhidhameyya. kālena kālaṃ udakena paripphoseyya. kālena kālaṃ ajjhupekkheyya. taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ dhantaṃ sudhantaṃ niddhantaṃ nīhaṭaṃ nīhaṭakasāvaṃ mudu ca kammaññaṃ ca pabhassarañca. yassā yassā ca piḷandhanavikatiyā ākaṅkhati, yadi pavaddhikāya yadi kuṇḍalāya yadi gīveyyakāya yadi suvaṇṇamālāya, tañcassa atthaṃ anubhoti.

mn140:23.1: so sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedeti. sā aniccāti pajānāti, anajjhositāti pajānāti, anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
mn140:23.2: dukkhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedeti. sā aniccāti pajānāti. anajjhositāti pajānāti. abhinanditāti pajānāti.
mn140:23.3: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vedeti, sā aniccāti pajānāti, anajjhositāti pajānāti, anabhinanditāti pajānāti.

mn140:24.3: adukkhamasukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedeti, visaṃyutto taṃ na vedeti.
mn140:24.4: so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti. jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti.
mn140:24.5: kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantī’ti pajānāti.

mn140:24.8: evameva kho bhikkhu, kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti. jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti.

mn140:28.4: svāssa pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
mn140:28.5: tasseva kho pana pubbe aviddasuno avijjā hoti sammoho sampadoso,
mn140:28.6: svāssa pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
mn140:28.7: tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena upasamādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti.
mn140:28.8: eso hi bhikkhu, paramo ariyo upasamo yadidaṃ
mn140:29.1: ‘paññaṃ nappamajjeyya, saccamanurakkheyya, cāgamanubrūheyya, santimeva so sikkheyyā’ti
mn140:29.2: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn140:30.1: yattha ṭhitaṃ maññussavā nappavattanti. maññussave kho pana appavattamāne muni santoti vuccatī’ti
mn140:30.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
mn140:31.1: asmīti bhikkhu maññitametaṃ. ayamahamasmīti. maññitametaṃ. bhavissanti maññitametaṃ. na bhavissanti maññitametaṃ. rūpī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ. arūpī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ. saññī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ. asaññī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ. nevasaññīnāsaññī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ.
mn140:31.2: maññitaṃ bhikkhu rogo, maññitaṃ gaṇḍo, maññitaṃ sallaṃ.
mn140:31.3: sabbamaññitānaṃ tveva bhikkhu, samatikkamā muni santoti vuccati.
mn140:31.4: muni kho pana bhikkhu, santo na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na kuppati na vihesati.
mn140:31.5: tampissa bhikkhu natthi, yena jāyetha, ajāyamāno kiṃ jīyissati, ajīyamāno kiṃ mīyissati, amīyamāno kiṃ kuppissati, akuppamāno kissa vihessati.
mn140:32.1: ‘yattha ṭhitaṃ maññussavā nappavattanti. maññussave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santoti vuccatī’ti
mn140:32.2: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
mn140:32.3: imaṃ kho me tvaṃ bhikkhu, saṅkhittena cha dhātuvibhaṅgaṃ dhārehīti.
mn140:33.2: ‘satthā kira me anuppatto, sugato kira me anuppatto, sammāsambuddho kira me anuppatto’ti uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn140:33.3: ‘accayo maṃ bhante, accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yohaṃ bhagavantaṃ āvusovādena samudācaritabbaṃ amaññissaṃ.
mn140:33.4: tassa me bhante, bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā’ti.
mn140:33.5: taggha tvaṃ bhikkhu, accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ āvusovādena samudācaritabbaṃ amaññittha.
mn140:33.6: yato ca kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, accayaṃ accayato disvā yathā dhammaṃ paṭikarosi. taṃ te mayaṃ patigaṇhāma. vuddhi
mn140:33.7: hesā bhikkhu, ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti, āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatī’ti.
mn140:34.3: na kho me bhante, paripuṇṇaṃ pattacīvaranti.
mn140:34.4: na kho bhikkhu, tathāgatā aparipuṇṇapattacīvaraṃ upasampādentīti.
mn140:35.1: atha kho āyasmā pukkusāti bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pattacīvarapariyesanaṃ pakkāmi.
mn140:35.2: atha kho āyasmantaṃ pukkusātiṃ pattacīvarapariyesanaṃ carantaṃ bhantagāvī jīvitā voropesi.
mn140:36.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā, tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn140:36.2: ‘yo so, bhante, pukkusāti nāma kulaputto bhagavatā saṅkhittena ovādena ovadito, so kālaṅkato.
mn140:36.4: paṇḍito bhikkhave, pukkusāti kulaputto, paccapādi dhammassānudhammaṃ. na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ viheṭhesi.
mn140:36.5: pukkusāti bhikkhave, kulaputto pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokāti.
mn140:36.7: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
